# v0.4.1 — Heartbeat recovery and charging controls

This release recovers missing-heartbeat faults automatically after updates or
temporary interruptions and makes the charging controls easier to use.
The minimum remains **Home Assistant 2026.9.0**.

- **Automatic recovery:** in Modbus master mode, error 200 is recovered once
  heartbeat delivery resumes. It respects a pause or device lock, retains the
  current limit, and makes at most three attempts while the fault persists.
  A previous unlimited setting is restored after the five-second write floor.
- **Heartbeat sensor:** a diagnostic problem sensor shows healthy delivery or
  a missed ten-second deadline. It remains meaningful when register polling
  fails and produces history only when health changes, not at every heartbeat.
- **Repairs:** resolved issues disappear. Manual repair reports connection
  failures, write cooldowns and a still-active fault with useful messages.
  A healthy wallbox receives no recovery commands; recovery no longer raises
  a live 6 A limit merely because a saved setpoint is missing.
- **Pause and resume:** the five-minute manual lockout is removed. The
  five-second current-write floor remains; phase changes retain their separate
  five-minute guard. PV automation hysteresis still defaults to six minutes.
- **Current slider:** the charging-current limit is a slider again. **0 A
  removes the EMS limit**; 6 A or more sets a limit. Values between 0 and 6 A
  are rejected. Use the separate pause switch to stop charging.

Automatic recovery is built in. **Disable an existing “Recover from a lost
heartbeat” blueprint automation** to avoid duplicate attempts. The manual
recovery button remains available and can lift a pause; after manual recovery,
select 0 again if you want unlimited mode.

Existing entries, device IDs and entity IDs are retained. Update through HACS
and complete the requested Home Assistant restart. No entry migration is
needed. A new hardware test of these changes is still pending.

Validation covers minimum and latest stable Home Assistant, the real repairs
flow, automatic startup recovery and a SQLite Recorder regression test:
100 successful heartbeats add no state rows; a fault and recovery add two.

One installation archive serves HACS and the Marketplace:
**`ha-mennekes-amtron.zip`**, accompanied by checksums, build metadata and an
SPDX SBOM. The domain remains **`mennekes_amtron_rtu`**.
